name: hybrid-voxel-sprite
description: Agent skill for real-time articulated 3D voxel sprites: per-part T3 OBB raymarching, analytic inverse deform, a stdlib-only SVOX CLI and verified adapters for WebGL2 / Three.js, Godot 4, Unity 6 URP and Blender 5. v2.3 adds a Megastructure / Capital Ship track for ~1000 u ships: quad16 (16 B/quad instanced) and packed20 (20 B/vert) formats, a 12 MiB hero budget, faction materials, Multi-Cue and Hull-Only G5 concept-diff gates and a G6 perf gate, via a zero-dependency Node kit (69/69 self-test).
